name: bujjet
description: bujjet Android app (Capacitor wrapper around the same index.html as bujjet.com)

scripts.www: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html manifest.json privacy.html terms.html icon-192.png icon-512.png icon-maskable.png www/ && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/ && sed -i '0,/<script>/s//<script src="capacitor.js"><\/script>\n<script>/' www/index.html && grep -c 'capacitor.js' www/index.html
